## History

Before arriving at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), James A. had lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), after visiting the [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island) during his childhood. He had promised his dying sister that he would marry [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott, but he later separated from [Emily](../character/emily.md) after a dispute involving [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), a parrot gifted to him by his dying brother. Upon Emily's unexpected arrival at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), James secretly felt glad to have his long-estranged wife back.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), +1 more_
